title: Pieter Claesz, Memento Mori, 1000 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description Pieter Claesz captured a moment of silence and focus in this painting. The skull, goblet and candle create a composition that draws attention to what is fragile and fleeting. The restrained palette and balanced light give the scene a raw, contemplative character. The Dark Edition silver coin translates this atmosphere into an elegant collectible form.
